about.text: An unripened, semi-dry white cheese made by artisanal plants in Nicaragua, which collect milk from many farms. The curd is salted, moulded and pressed for 24 hours into 25 kg blocks. It is firm but soft-textured, similar in appearance to feta, and does not melt when heated.
